courses.summary: 光子晶片製程設計套件以PDK 版本、設計規則、模型角落與封裝交接連結元件物理與系統驗證。此代表地點用於認識研究與封裝供應鏈；課程由多個公開來源交叉編寫。
courses.summaryEn: Photonic process-design kits links device physics and system validation through PDK versions, design rules, model corners and assembly handoff. This representative location illustrates the research and packaging ecosystem; the curriculum draws on several public sources.
courses.connection: 以PDK 版本、設計規則、模型角落與封裝交接比較相關工法；重新核對材料、波段、控制拓撲與驗收門檻。
courses.connectionEn: Compare related methods through PDK versions, design rules, model corners and assembly handoff, rechecking materials, wavelength, control topology and acceptance limits.

history.title: 封裝介面提早進入設計
history.text: AIM 公開 ADK 說明將封裝考量放入設計流程。本課把元件模型、設計規則和可組裝性放在同一版本化交付表。
history.textEn: The public AIM ADK description brings packaging considerations into design. This course joins component models, rules and assembly feasibility in a versioned handoff.
